title: The Frost Giant's Cup
text: A cup of ice the size of a cart stands abandoned on the glacier, its rim carved with runes. Something inside it still steams, dark and thick and smelling of honey and blood. Huge footprints lead away into the white. They are not very old.

options.label: The toughest drinks from the giant's cup, daring to taste what giants drink.

outcomes.text: Giant's mead. They feel enormous, and very loud, and they sing all the way down the glacier.
Giant's poison, thick and sweet, and cramping, and it does not want to leave.

options.label: Chip off the cup's rim. Giant ice never melts, and it will sell.

outcomes.text: It sells for a fortune to anyone who wants to keep things cold.

options.label: Wait for the giant to come back, and face it at its own cup.

outcomes.text: It comes back thirsty, and finds you at its cup, and it is not the sharing kind.
